sources.snippet: π₀.₅ (lerobot/pi05_base) full fine-tune on mliu48/telearms-yam-cube-v5-exp-random-500 (revision c4245e61): 5,000 simulated bimanual YAM demonstrations of 10 tasks, 4,706,102 frames at 30 Hz, three 224×224 cameras, no domain randomization.

sources.title: GitHub - Ailiee/pi05
sources.snippet: the π₀ model, a flow-based vision-language-action model (VLA). the π₀-FAST model, an autoregressive VLA, based on the FAST action tokenizer. the π₀.₅ model, an upgraded version of π₀ with better open-world generalization trained with knowledge insulation.
